description: A customer's interim pricing for the duration of a declared Force Majeure event (IDEV-3129). Goes through the "Force Majeure Pricing Approval" workflow: a Force Majeure User drafts and submits for approval, a Force Majeure Manager approves (docstatus 1) or rejects. Only an APPROVED doc governs. While it governs it SUPPRESSES the standard contract rate and the deal discount on Sales Order, Delivery Note and Sales Invoice. All four gates must hold: Fuelbuddy Settings > Enable Force Majeure, a submitted Force Majeure Trigger covering the date, the Customer's Force Majeure Active flag, and the transaction date inside Effective Start..Effective End. Cancel the doc to revert -- or, once invoices are already billed under it, have a Force Majeure Manager shorten Effective End; nothing is back-dated.

fields.description: First transaction date this override applies to (inclusive).
fields.label: Effective Start

fields.description: Last transaction date this override applies to (inclusive). The ONE field a Force Majeure Manager may still change after approval -- to stop the event early for months not yet billed without cancelling the Pricing. It can never be moved before the latest invoice already billed under this Pricing.
fields.label: Effective End

fields.description: One row per fuel SKU. An item with no row here keeps its standard contract rate even while the override is live, so an empty table simply overrides nothing.
fields.label: Items

name: Force Majeure Pricing
